JVNDB-2026-000110
Installer for Rakuten Kobo Desktop Application (Windows version) may insecurely load Dynamic Link Libraries
Overview
The installer for Rakuten Kobo Desktop Application (Windows version) contains the following vulnerability in the DLL search path, which may lead to insecurely loading Dynamic Link Libraries.
Uncontrolled search path element (CWE-427) - CVE-2026-68955
Yukihiro Nakamura reported this vulnerability to IPA.
JPCERT/CC coordinated with the developer under Information Security Early Warning Partnership.

Affected Products
Rakuten Kobo Inc.
Rakuten Kobo desktop Application (Windows version) installer distributed before July 15, 2026
Impact
If there is a crafted DLL at the same directory when invoking the affected installer, arbitrary code may be executed with the privileges of the user who performed the installation.
Solution
[Use the latest installer]
Use the latest installer provided by the developer.
This vulnerability can only be exploited when the installer is invoked. If the product has already been installed, reinstallation is not required.
